desc: Server admin command that announces to this server and to every other server via a messaging hub, skipping its own JobId to avoid double messages.

title: Core SendNotification with button
desc: Uses the built-in StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification") with a Join button + BindableFunction callback to prompt group join every few minutes if not a member.

title: Favorite / join-group nudge
desc: Favorite / join-group nudge shown when using a shop prompt: native favorite dialog (AvatarEditorService) first, then a small group card; 5-minute cooldown if ignored.

title: Gamepass buy button
desc: World SurfaceGui gamepass buy button: hover/press tweens, anti double-prompt, listens to PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished and flips to "Purchased".

title: Floating cash and error text
desc: Floating "+N coins!" / "+N skips!" text with random drift and rotation, plus red error text from client (BindableEvent) or server (RemoteEvent).

title: Toast queue (pattern)
desc: Stacking toasts with Success/Error/Info/Warning styles, duplicate merge with (xN), max visible, auto-dismiss, optional sounds.

title: Confirm dialog (pattern)
desc: Yielding modal: Ask() returns true/false, Message() and Choose(); queued, Enter/Escape and gamepad A/B, optional timeout.

title: Announcer (pattern)
desc: Server-to-client announcement banners (player, server, or all servers via MessagingService) with queued display and optional avatar headshot.

title: Purchase prompt wrapper (pattern)
desc: Yielding wrapper for game pass / developer product prompts with anti-double-prompt lock, timeout, pending callback and ownership cache.

title: Stalker monster state machine
desc: Backrooms entity with IDLE/STALK/FLEE/CHASE states: hears players in a radius, hides behind cover found by raycast sampling, peeks, flees when looked at (dot-product + raycast), sometimes snaps into a chase and plays a jumpscare kill.

title: Anchored-NPC pathfinding module
desc: Reusable module that moves anchored (non-Humanoid) NPC models along PathfindingService waypoints with ground-snapping raycasts, smooth turning, and a chase() loop that re-paths on a timer or when the target moves.

title: Zombie chase / wander AI
desc: Classic per-zombie Script: finds the nearest player on the 'Alive' team, pathfinds toward them, wanders randomly when no one is near, and deals touch damage with a per-victim cooldown.

title: Wave-based zombie round loop
desc: Wave spawner: zombies per wave = base * wave * multiplier, a timed spawn loop over tagged Spawner parts, and a round loop that advances the wave when all zombies die, ends in victory on the last wave or defeat when no players are alive.

title: Alive-enemy registry
desc: Small module that registers / unregisters spawned zombies, prunes destroyed ones and pushes the 'enemies left' count to clients.

title: Blind 'Figure' hunter (hears movement)
desc: DOORS-style Figure: patrols a Nodes folder, but while 'blind' only targets players moving faster than a speed threshold (hearing); uses direct movement when it has line of sight and pathfinding otherwise; grab-and-kill on touch; crucifix check.

title: Rush entity room sweep
desc: DOORS-style Rush: flickers lights, spawns a few rooms behind the players, then lerps the entity through each room's RoomStart->RoomEnd pathfinding waypoints at a fixed speed and awards a survival badge; supports crucifix cancel.

title: Room path-node generator
desc: Computes a path from a room's RoomStart to RoomEnd once and stores the waypoints as numbered invisible parts (PathNodes) so entities can follow them later.

title: Configurable patrol / attack bot
desc: Admin-system bot brain driven by a props table (Target, Swarm, PatrolZone, PatrolDist, Damage, team friendliness) set through a BindableEvent; patrols random points, targets the nearest valid model, walks straight when it can see the goal and pathfinds otherwise, with a forward-ray jump check.

title: Soldier AI with perception meter
desc: ACS-gun enemy soldier: patrol / chase / memory modes, a perception value that fills while the player is visible before it starts shooting, memory that decays when sight is lost, walk speeds per state, spread, and armour-aware damage. (Same script is reused for CQC/HMG/Sniper with different settings.)

title: Zone guardian boss (steal-and-run chaser)
desc: Giant guardian per egg zone: wanders its zone, chases any player carrying an egg from it with a wind-up, target-leading (aims where the player will be), speed matched to the zone's recommended speed, safe-zone wall, leash/give-up rules, knock-back on hit and fast return home. Physics driven by LinearVelocity + AlignOrientation. Comments are in French.

title: Two-phase arena boss with minions
desc: Server-authoritative boss fight: HP pool, timed ground-slam shockwave you must jump, teleports, and below 50% HP a phase 2 that spawns exploding dog minions that chase the nearest player on a fuse timer. Visuals are driven by attributes / a client FX remote. Comments are in French.

title: Wandering swarm event
desc: Timed event that spawns 20-30 small NPCs at wander points, moves each with SimplePath (path Costs avoid water/lava), picks a new random point after Reached, swaps idle/walk animations from Humanoid.Running, and scans a box around each NPC to apply a trait to nearby targets.

title: Lightweight wander runtime
desc: Tiny module that registers rigs and, every 5 seconds per rig, MoveTo's a random point 10-20 studs away; one Heartbeat connection per rig with Disconnect / DisconnectAll.

title: NPC dialogue module (typewriter + choices)
desc: Client OOP dialogue: list of {text, responses} where a response can jump to another entry (next) or close with an exit quip; typewriter text with tick sound, NPC turns to face the player, optional camera part lock, 1/2 keyboard shortcuts, hides other players, closes when you walk away.

title: Clickable-bubble NPC conversation (client)
desc: Speech bubbles over NPC heads that start a server-driven conversation; server sends choices, client shows up to 5 response buttons, ends the chat if the player walks more than 30 studs away or another player is already talking to that NPC; gamepad support.

title: Visitor / customer queue NPCs
desc: Service that spawns visitor NPCs (unique or generic), walks them through the front door to a counter with pathfinding + MoveTo timeouts, uses a collision group so they pass through doors, seats them in a waiting room (claim chair, sit pose), then leaves and despawns. Comments are in Spanish.

title: Ambient NPCs that fill seats
desc: Keeps a global NPC count under a limit by picking random free stools at casino games (priority games first), spawning an avatar NPC on the seat with sit animation, nametag and a per-NPC play script.

title: Idle NPC that looks at and waves to you
desc: Client script for NPCs tagged 'LookAtNpc': breathing idle via Motor6D C0 offsets, head + waist turn toward the local player (clamped yaw/pitch, smoothed), one wave when you come close, re-greets after you leave. Comments are in French.

title: Companion follower
desc: Buddy NPC that MoveTo's just behind its owner when further than 3.4 studs, teleports behind them past 21.5 studs, jumps when the owner jumps (remote) and cleans itself up when the owner dies or leaves.

title: Humanoid path follower
desc: Clean module: follows PathfindingService waypoints with timeouts, stuck detection, Blocked re-path, line-of-sight check and a Chase() that re-paths on interval or target movement.

title: Monster chaser brain
desc: Clean PATROL/CHASE/SEARCH/RETURN state machine with sight cone, hearing of fast-moving players, perception meter, memory, leash and melee attack.

title: Enemy wave spawner
desc: Clean server wave runner: per-wave enemy budget, batched spawns at tagged points, max-alive cap, signals for wave start / enemy died / wave cleared.

title: Server-side NPC dialogue tree
desc: Clean data-driven dialogue: nodes with choices, conditions, server actions and next jumps; validates the client's choice index and distance.

title: Minimal weighted roll
desc: Smallest possible weighted pick: sum the weights, draw math.random()*total, walk the list until the running sum passes the draw.

title: Pet weight table (1-in-N odds)
desc: Pet data table where each pet has a raw weight; the game shows odds as 1/(total/weight). Shows how RNG games go from 1/2 to 1/10,000,000+ by dividing tiny weights.

title: Roll reveal UI + auto-roll (client)
desc: Client roll button: flashes 4 fake results then the real one in a viewport, auto-roll gamepass toggle, luck applied by multiplying rare weights. WARNING: the roll happens on the client and the server trusts the pet name.

title: Rare-roll global announcement + badges
desc: Server side of the roll: converts weight to '1/N', awards badges at 1/100, 1/1000 ... and broadcasts very rare rolls to every server through MessagingService.

title: Pet follow with AlignPosition
desc: Equips a pet model that follows the player using Attachment + AlignPosition/AlignOrientation, with a bobbing tween that changes speed while the player walks.

title: Server egg hatching (Knit)
desc: Full server-authoritative egg opening: rate limit, amount clamp, currency check, luck via weight^(1/luck), Golden/Toxic tier roll, stacking duplicates, index tracking, quest hooks, global luck events.

title: Pet equip / lock / delete service
desc: Server pet inventory actions: equip with slot cap from upgrades + gamepasses, unequip, delete (blocked if locked), lock toggle, nickname length cap.

title: Pet formation offsets (rows / arcs)
desc: Pure function that lays equipped pets out in up to 3 arcs behind the player (small pets front, big pets middle, huge pets back) and returns a CFrame offset per pet.

title: Luck multiplier stacking
desc: One function that adds every luck source together: server flag, global event, upgrades, gamepasses, potions, fruits, events and the equipped aura. Same code runs on client (for display) and server (for the roll).

title: Luck that moves % from common to rare
desc: getNewChances: multiplies the chance of 'luck-affected' pets and subtracts the same total from the common pets so the egg still sums to 100%. Also pet descriptor / rarity helpers.

title: Aura dice roll + aura levels
desc: Bundle of AuraService (consume a dice item, roll an aura on the server) and AuraUtils (luck redistribution with clamping, aura XP level/progress).

title: RNG roll with zone pools, mutations and special rolls
desc: Server roll: builds a pool from zone-unlocked slimes, boosts rare tiers with amplifiers, rolls independent mutations (huge/big/shiny/inverted), auto-equips, updates the index and counts down golden/diamond/void 'every N rolls' special rolls.

title: Random timed server luck events
desc: Every 5-10 minutes picks a weighted luck multiplier (x2 common ... x50 rare) and turns on a 5 minute server luck event through the admin luck service.

title: Index / collection tracking + rewards
desc: Index service: migrates old saves into the index (retroactively unlocking owned slimes), tracks counts per category/mutation and hands out index milestone rewards.

title: Paid RNG slot machine with skill tree
desc: Server RNG machine: price-based reward weights, server picks the result and decoy reel entries for the client to animate, chance of a luck-multiplier result, mutation skills, timed buy offer and delivery to a free podium.

title: Mutation data layout
desc: Two entries of the mutation table: each mutation has a display name, rich text, sort order, roll Weight, income Modifier, icon and colour palettes used to recolour the model.

title: Replicated server luck timer
desc: Tiny service that holds a server-wide luck index and end time in a replicated channel and counts it down once per second.

title: Event spin wheel (server)
desc: Server spin wheel: weighted reward with alternate reward if already owned, per-player cooldown, spin tokens given out by a UTC-scheduled event, reward applied after the client animation delay.

title: Lucky block opening with luck tier-up
desc: Lucky block open flow: luck gives a chance per step to climb a rarity tier (capped at +2), skips invalid ids, falls back along the rarity ladder, and holds rewards as 'pending' until the reveal animation confirms (auto-applies on timeout or leave).

title: Server-wide pity timers
desc: Conveyor spawner where Legendary / Mythical / Secret never roll randomly; instead a countdown per rarity guarantees one when it hits zero, with a world sign showing the time left.

title: Egg spawn / size / pet rolls with luck event
desc: Three roll helpers: luck() reads a server attribute, rollHeight() picks a size tier, pickKey() boosts every egg except the most common one during a luck event, and hatch() picks the pet and stacks event mutations.

title: Placed egg incubation + hatch
desc: Eggs placed in the player's base incubate until ReadyAt, can randomly grow heavier while waiting, then hatch on the server (inventory cap check, roll by % table, egg weight carried into the pet).

title: Cross-server luck event
desc: Admin-started x4 luck event shared by all servers: end time saved in a DataStore (new servers pick it up), broadcast with MessagingService, per-server option, and a resync loop.

title: Weighted table with luck modes
desc: Weighted random table with BoostRare / Exponent / Shift luck, binary-search roll, RollMany and 1/N odds text.

title: Pity counter (hard / soft / every-N)
desc: Per-player, per-banner hard and soft pity plus every-N-rolls bonus counters stored in a saveable table.

title: Server egg hatcher
desc: Server-authoritative egg hatch: argument validation, cooldown, spend-before-roll, tier and mutation rolls, index marking; plugs into any data layer.

title: Client pet follower
desc: Client-side pet follow with size-based arc formation, frame-rate independent lerp and walk/idle bobbing.

title: All-in-one Audio module (SFX + crossfade music)
desc: One module for all audio: Play() one-shot SFX on a part or at a world position (random pick from an ID list), PlayMusic() with automatic crossfade, StopMusic(), a mute toggle that caches volumes, and a garbage collector that cleans finished sounds. Server calls are forwarded to all clients.

title: Promise-based sound player
desc: Plays a named sound from an assets folder (clone, optional position part, pitch via PitchShiftSoundEffect), returns a Promise that resolves when it ends, and cleans up with a Trove. Server calls broadcast to clients; respects the SFX setting.

title: Positional one-shot sound helper
desc: Tiny helper: clone a Sound, put it on a part or at a world position (via a Terrain attachment), route it to a SoundGroup, set speed and start time, optionally fade it out after a delay, and auto-clean with Debris.

title: State-driven music crossfade
desc: Two looping tracks (background and run music) that crossfade with TweenService whenever the player state changes (here: a morph model exists on the character).

title: Client music loop with watchdog
desc: Client-driven background music with a watchdog: picks the song from SoundService.Music, forces Looped, and restarts it on Ended/Stopped/Paused or if a 2-second check finds it silent. Explains why music should be driven on the client.

title: Minimal seasonal playlist
desc: Minimal background playlist: one Sound in SoundService cycles through a list of IDs on Ended; picks a seasonal (Halloween) playlist from a Lighting attribute. Comments are in French.

title: Random-start looping playlist
desc: Simple looping playlist: starts at a random track, waits for Loaded before playing, advances (wrapping) on Ended; includes a forward/back position helper.

title: Location and time-of-day music
desc: Location-aware music: chooses a track by season/holiday/time of day, switches to house music players or shop songs when the player enters a zone, fades out and in between tracks and resumes the outdoor song where it left off. Volume comes from a settings slider.

title: ZonePlus area music
desc: Area music using ZonePlus: each part in workspace.AudioZones holds a Sound that fades in when the local player enters and fades out on exit; the gym and nightclub zones pick a new random track every loop.

title: Reverb zones (AmbientReverb)
desc: Turns on SoundService.AmbientReverb (ConcertHall) while the player is inside any invisible TunnelArea part, using a cheap box check on Heartbeat and only changing the property when the state flips.

title: Client/server SoundFX with zone broadcast
desc: Shared client/server sound helper: on the client plays a named sound from a folder; on the server either tells one client to play it or plays it on an object; PlaySoundInsideZone sends a sound only to players standing inside a zone box.

title: Event sound sequence with screen flash
desc: Server-triggered event stingers: plays a sequence of named sounds one after another (waiting on Ended) and syncs a full-screen white flash to one of them, using a token so overlapping flashes cancel cleanly.

title: Global UI click sound
desc: Global UI click sound: hooks every GuiButton in PlayerGui (now and later, via DescendantAdded) plus every ProximityPrompt trigger, preloads the sound, and plays a short-lived clone.

title: Button hover/click sounds and bounce
desc: Auto-adds hover/press scale bounce plus hover and click sounds to every GuiButton, with random pitch and SoundService:PlayLocalSound; also plays a window-opened sound when a large Main/Window/Panel frame becomes visible. Falls back to built-in sounds if an asset fails to load. Comments are in French.

title: Touch-triggered click sounds
desc: Plays a click when any character part touches a keycap part, with a per-part debounce and random pitch so repeated clicks sound natural. Uses one shared Sound in SoundService.

title: Material-based footsteps
desc: Footstep sounds chosen by Humanoid.FloorMaterial (3 random variations per material, with aliases), fired from an animation marker (runfootstep) with a rate limit; also jump and land sounds from StateChanged.

title: 3D boss roars with rolloff
desc: 3D positional roars for tagged bosses while they chase: per-boss sound config (id, volume, pitch), linear rolloff from 40 to 190 studs, random offsets so bosses do not roar in sync, fade-out before destroy, muted in safe zone and arenas. Comments are in French.

title: Fade sound group in/out
desc: Fades a group of sounds under an attachment in or out (1 s linear tween), remembering each original volume in an attribute; honors a per-player Awakening Music setting.

title: Music/SFX sliders with SoundGroup routing
desc: Settings panel with Music and SFX volume sliders. Creates Music and SFX SoundGroups and auto-routes every Sound in the game into one of them (long looped sounds count as music), drag-to-set sliders in 5 percent steps for mouse and touch, saves on release, loads saved values from player attributes. Comments are in French.

title: Volume settings DataStore save
desc: Server half of the volume settings: loads Music/SFX volume from its own DataStore into player attributes, validates values sent by the client remote, and writes once on leave or BindToClose. Comments are in French.

title: Volume sliders with debounced save
desc: Settings controller with Music and Sounds volume sliders (tweened fill bar and knob). Applies volume to every Sound in SoundService.Music and SoundService.Sounds, including ones added later, and debounces saves to the server (0.3 s task.delay cancelled on each new change).

title: PlaybackLoudness bar visualizer
desc: Bar-graph audio visualizer driven by Sound.PlaybackLoudness: keeps a rolling buffer of loudness samples, mirrors it from the center outwards, tweens bar heights and optionally colors bars from a ColorSequence. Note: Frame:Add() is an Adonis helper; replace it with Instance.new.

title: RPM-driven engine sound layers
desc: A-Chassis engine sound plugin: four looping layers (exhaust, engine, idle, redline) whose volume, pitch, distortion and EQ are computed from RPM and throttle each time RPM changes.

title: MusicPlayer pattern
desc: Playlist with shuffle, crossfades, priority override layers for zones/bosses and resume of the interrupted track.

title: UISounds pattern
desc: Auto hover/click sounds on every GuiButton with preload, pitch jitter and per-button attributes.

title: AmbienceZones pattern
desc: Tagged zone parts drive crossfaded ambience and SoundService.AmbientReverb.

title: AudioSettings pattern
desc: Music/SFX SoundGroups with auto-routing, debounced save and DataStore persistence (server + client).

title: Trade session state machine
desc: Server-authoritative trade flow: request, offers, READY, enforced wait, CONFIRM, atomic swap, rate-limited remote.

title: Atomic inventory swap
desc: All-or-nothing swap of two item sets with ownership, duplicate, lock, capacity and id-collision checks.

title: Pending delivery inbox
desc: DataStore mailbox to deliver items to offline or other-server players, claimed on join or ping.

title: Trade machine server
desc: Same-server pet trade with READY->wait->CONFIRM, edit cooldowns, request expiry and action rate limit.

title: Trade bridge atomic swap
desc: Excerpt: data-owner BindableFunction that lists tradable pets and executes an all-or-nothing swap.

title: Code-built trade UI
desc: Complete trade window built in code: lobby, request cards with timers, offer grids, ready/confirm countdown.

title: Cross-server escrow trade
desc: Cross-server trade that escrows pets per server then delivers through a DataStore inbox with offer signatures.

title: Tool trade server
desc: Clean trade module for Tool items with InTrade lock, request timeout and final re-validation.

title: Tool trade client
desc: Client for tool trades: request toasts with countdown, player list, viewport item previews.

title: Cross-server trade service
desc: Trades across servers using MemoryStore sessions, a presence map for search, and MessagingService sync.

title: Cross-server trade client
desc: Client with live cross-server player search, request popup and offer grids.

title: Podium trade service
desc: Production trade service for base animals: invites, local and cross-server handshake, ready delay, steal checks.

title: Knit trade service
desc: Knit trade of stackable items plus currency tokens with separate ready and confirm stages.

title: Trading plaza booths
desc: Booth marketplace with escrowed listings and token purchases (has known bugs, see README).

title: OOP trade class
desc: Trade object with Trove cleanup, state tracker and attribute-replicated state; unreadies on data change.

title: OOP trade request
desc: Trade request object decided by the target via RemoteFunction, then creates the Trade.

title: Trade eligibility check
desc: canOccur gate: both loaded, target allows trades, neither already trading.

title: Instance-based trade handler
desc: Trade state as a cloned Folder of Value objects, confirm then accept, save lock while swapping.

title: NPC recipe trader
desc: Rotating NPC offers that consume a recipe of brainrots; contains an insecure update remote to remove.

title: Steal start / cancel / complete service
desc: Server side of a Steal-a-Brainrot style steal: StartSteal marks the victim's podium as being stolen, welds the animal model in front of the thief, slows them to 75% speed and plays a carry...

title: Steal-game plot service (assign, lock, steal remote, income)
desc: Full plot/base service for a steal game: hands out free plots, syncs the podium list to a per-plot replicated channel, 30s spawn grace lock, LockBase (timed laser lock that grows with rebirths and...

title: Steal remote validation + stale flag janitor
desc: The server's Steal remote handler (type-checks args, rejects if already stealing, confirms the thief's HumanoidRootPart is inside the victim plot's StealHitbox with GetPartBoundsInBox) plus a...

title: Steal guard rails (locks, cooldown, join protection)
desc: The guard rails a later Steal-a-Brainrot build added around StartSteal: a per-podium steal lock so two thieves can't grab the same item, a 1s steal cooldown, no stealing from players who are...

title: Switch to another free base
desc: Lets a player move to a different free base: a RemoteFunction lists free plots, a RemoteEvent requests the move, with a 3s per-player cooldown and a server-side re-check that the target plot is...

title: Base tier data (rebirth -> model, max podiums)
desc: Data table mapping rebirth level to base model (first/second/third floor template) and MaxAnimals (podium count)

title: Fixed-plot manager with floor upgrades
desc: Simple, readable plot system: 8 fixed plots, first free index goes to the joining player, extra floors are shown/hidden as the player buys base upgrades (price + rebirth requirement per level),...

title: Podium slots: place, collect, upgrade
desc: Podium/slot logic for a brainrot tycoon: place the held tool on an empty slot, swap or pick up from an occupied one, slots accumulate money over time, touch a collect pad to cash out, and level up...

title: Conveyor belt spawner with pity and delivery to base
desc: Server conveyor belt: spawns a weighted-random brainrot every few seconds at point A, lerps it to point B, players press E in range to buy it, then it walks to the buyer's base (stealable in...

title: Head-stack carry system with collection zone
desc: Carry stack: picked-up items are kept as data and shown as massless, non-colliding models welded in a stack above the player's head; walking into the CollectionZone (checked every 0.2s with a...

title: Minimal plot assigner
desc: The smallest clean plot assigner in the set (~100 lines): sorts plots by number, gives the first one with OwnerUserId == 0, teleports the player there on every spawn, and runs registered reset...

title: Base floor upgrades from templates
desc: Buy-the-next-floor base upgrades: keeps floor/podium templates out of the world, clones the unlocked ones into the player's plot per level, charges a per-level cost, throttles requests with a 1s...

title: Plot slots with revisioned owner snapshots
desc: Plot slots with a revision number: assigns numbered plots, sets the sign (name + headshot), replicates owner-by-slot snapshots to clients, teleports to the plot on spawn, exposes plot capacity,...

title: Egg carry, claim and validated placement
desc: Carry-and-deliver plus validated placement: pick up an egg (distance <= 28 studs, one at a time, ownership check), drop/reset it, guards knock it out of your hands, crossing a separation line...

title: Classic tycoon kit purchase handler
desc: Classic berezaa tycoon kit purchase handler: collector part turns 'Cash' drops into stored cash, a giver pad pays it out to the owner, and every button clones its purchase into the tycoon when bought

title: Classic tycoon kit parts (regen, gate, dropper, upgrader, conveyor)
desc: The remaining pieces of the classic tycoon kit: CoreScript (backs up each tycoon and regenerates it when the owner leaves), the claim gate, a dropper (spawns a Part with a Cash IntValue every few...

title: Hand-made tycoon (claim, buy pads, droppers, collector, laser)
desc: A small hand-made tycoon: claim via RemoteEvent, buy pads that reveal a dropper/upgrade and enable it, droppers that clone a Drop on a cooldown, an upgrader that doubles each drop once, a...

title: House furniture placement in local space
desc: Server side of placing furniture in a player house: enforces a per-upgrade furniture cap, removes one from inventory, and stores the CFrame relative to the house's Marker part (ToObjectSpace) so...

title: Plot manager pattern
desc: Assign/release plots, teleport on spawn, signals and move-to-free-plot.

title: Data-driven tycoon kit pattern
desc: Buttons with dependencies, Heartbeat droppers, upgraders, conveyors, collector and save/load of purchases.

title: Server-authoritative steal system pattern
desc: Zone-checked steals with slot locks, carry weld, delivery, timeouts and server-enforced base locks.

title: Plot placement grid pattern
desc: Shared grid snapping, rotation, bounds/overlap checks and plot-local CFrame save format with server validation.

title: Button hover/press FX
desc: Hover grow / press squash / Back-out release on a UIScale, pitch-jittered sounds, touch fallback, autoBind for a whole PlayerGui.

title: Window pop-in / pop-out
desc: Open from 80% with Back-out, close with Quad-in, optional CanvasGroup fade, blur and FOV, exclusive window groups.

title: Shine sweep
desc: Looping or one-shot diagonal shine: gradient band whose Offset tweens -1 -> 1; colour-band mode for text.

title: Rotating gradients + sunbursts
desc: One shared Heartbeat (throttled to 30 Hz) spins UIGradients and ray images and pans gradients; tag binding; rainbow builder.

title: Typewriter text
desc: MaxVisibleGraphemes reveal with rich-text support, punctuation pauses, pitch-jittered blips, skip / cancel / erase.

title: Number count-up
desc: Counter object with "ease" (cubic out) or "lerp" (exponential chase) modes, pop on increase, abbreviate() and commas().

title: Spring animator
desc: Exact damped-spring solver + controllers for UIScale or any number property, springy button binding, snap/kick.

title: Slide-in toasts
desc: Code-built toasts that slide in from a corner, stack, merge duplicates "(x3)", drain a timer bar, slide out and collapse the gap.

title: Tab underline slide
desc: Bar glides under the selected tab (optional stretchy two-phase motion), tints labels, pops the tab, follows resizes.

title: Progress bar fill
desc: Fill tween with skip-tiny-changes, ghost trail bar (damage drop / gain preview), percent label, onFull callback, X or Y axis.

title: Roll / reveal / wheel
desc: Slowing roll schedule with no-repeat rules, onTick/onReveal callbacks, spinWheelTo(slice), revealPop (slam + rays + flash), nudge.

title: Floating / bobbing icons
desc: Sine bob + rock + breathe for many icons from one RenderStepped, random phase per icon, tag binding with attributes.

title: Attention pulse / ripple
desc: Breathing UIScale loop, expanding UIStroke ripple rings, bell wiggle, pop, and a combined loop that pauses while hidden.

title: Screen transitions / flash
desc: Fade to colour, run code while covered (pcall-protected), typewriter title, fade back; quick colour flash.

title: 2D click sparkles / float text
desc: Frame-based radial sparkle bursts at any screen point, sparkles on every click, "+$N" text that pops then floats away.

title: Universal button FX + tag-driven effects
desc: Auto-hooks every GuiButton with hover/press UIScale tweens + sounds, and drives CollectionService-tagged effects (sunburst spin, rotating/panning UIGradient, random shine sparkles, looping UIScale pulse).

title: Grouped hover controller
desc: Button hover/press/bounce via a per-button UIScale with tween cancelling, hover groups (several buttons react as one), icon tilt, pooled hover sound and a throttled 30 Hz sunburst/gradient spinner.

title: Per-character animated text
desc: Per-character text animation: only changed characters drop/scale in with CSS cubic-bezier easing, CanvasGroup layers per glyph, value-increase pop via UIScale (AnimatedText.Pop). Advanced.

title: Window open/close manager with blur + FOV
desc: Window manager: Back-eased open / Quad-in close, blur + camera FOV tween, HUD groups slide off-screen while a window is open, cached fade tweens, open-by-button or by standing on a part.

title: Pop-in toast notifications
desc: Toast notifications that pop in on a UIScale (0 -> 1, Quart out) while fading every descendant, merge duplicates into "(xN)" with an overshoot pulse, and pop out with Back-in.

title: Badge ripple + wiggle
desc: Notification badge attention loop: two expanding UIStroke rings that fade out, a small UIScale pop, and a bell-style rotation wiggle every 2.6 s.

title: UIScale breathing pulse
desc: Minimal infinite "breathing" pulse: UIScale tween 1 -> 1.10, Sine InOut, repeat -1, reverses. Comment explains why UIScale beats Size tweening.

title: Rainbow ripple rings
desc: Train of expanding rainbow UIStroke rings on a BillboardGui around the player (rotating UIGradient per ring, fade as they grow).

title: Progress bar fill + pop-hold
desc: XP progress-bar fill tween (skips tiny changes), level text, and a "pop and hold" UIScale on stat gain that rests inflated while gains keep coming; coalesces refreshes per frame.

title: Click sparkle burst
desc: Pure 2D click/tap feedback: spawns radial dots and streak frames at the cursor that fly outward, shrink and fade.

title: HUD edge slide in/out
desc: Slides HUD groups off the top/left/bottom edges (Quart in/out, scale-only offscreen targets) and back in based on player location.

title: 2D confetti celebration
desc: Screen-space confetti burst built fully in code (image templates flung and fading) plus an optional world firework emitter burst.

title: Idle icon rock
desc: Endless Sine InOut rotation rock (+10 / -20 degrees) for an idle shop icon.

title: Cash count-up lerp
desc: Count-up currency display: exponential lerp of the displayed value toward the real value each frame (only rewriting Text when it changes) plus a Size pulse on change.

title: Button + window toggle tweening
desc: Button hover/press size tweens (original size stored as an attribute), keyboard-key press feedback, and a window toggle that grows from 5% with Back-out plus a camera FOV punch.

title: Compact button FX with sounds
desc: Compact global button FX: UIScale grow on hover, squash on press, Back-eased return, pitch-randomised sounds, mobile tap fallback, and a sound when big windows open. Comments in French.

title: Auto pop-in for windows
desc: Automatically pops every big window in from 80% scale (0.18 s Back out) when it becomes Visible, preserving any existing UIScale value. Comments in French.

title: Money count-up + gain popup
desc: Money counter with cubic ease-out count-up on RenderStepped, a "+$N" label that bursts out then rises and fades, batching of simultaneous gains, and a pop on spend. Comments in French.

title: Slowing roll + reveal
desc: Egg hatch reel that cycles silhouettes fast then slows (quadratic slot lengths), never repeats the result just before landing, then reveals with name tag pop, rays spin and highlight fade. Comments in French.

title: Zone entry banner
desc: Area-entry banner built in code: CanvasGroup fades in (GroupTransparency) while sliding down with Back-out, gradient title, auto-hides after 3 s. Comments in French.

title: Screen-edge danger pulse
desc: Danger alert: big "RUN!" text slams in from 2.4x scale, full-screen red flash, four gradient screen edges and the text heartbeat-pulse via sin() on RenderStepped. Comments in French.

title: Gradient polish + sun rays
desc: Upgrades every 2-colour UIGradient into a 4-stop "glossy" gradient and spins sun-ray images behind chosen icons. Needs the game PetPortrait.rays helper. Comments in French.

title: Floating reward popups
desc: "+$amount" reward popups at a random spot near screen centre: size pop with Back-out, content fade-in, then float up and fade out.

title: Merging alert stack
desc: Stacked alerts that grow from 0 size with Back-out, merge repeated item alerts by summing amounts, and shrink away after a lifetime.

title: Simple hover/press module
desc: Simple Size-based hover (1.1x) / press (0.8x) module with hover+click sounds, random icon tilt on hover, and keyboard-key press animation.

title: Screen transition + typewriter title
desc: Teleport transition: fades a full-screen frame in, tweens MaxVisibleGraphemes for a typewriter title, moves the character, then fades everything out.

title: RNG roll reveal
desc: RNG roll display: flashes 4 random results with a tiny shake, then the real one with rarity colour, "1/N" chance and an expanding ring; auto-roll loop.

title: Gradient shine sweep
desc: The classic shine sweep: tween a UIGradient Offset from (-1,0) to (1,0) every 2 s, then snap back.

title: Rainbow gradient sweep
desc: Endless rainbow sweep across a label: Offset sweep while rotating through a 15-colour HSV palette, flipping Rotation 0/180 each pass.

title: spr spring animator library
desc: The open-source "spr" spring library (MIT, Fraktality): spr.Target(instance, dampingRatio, frequency, {props}) animates any property with a critically/under-damped spring.

title: Spin wheel + spring window
desc: Reward wheel spin landing on a slot (5 full turns + slot offset, Quint out, 5 s) and window open/close driven by spr springs on Position, camera FOV and Blur.

title: Analytic spring class
desc: Classic analytic spring class (Quenty style): set .Target, read .Position each frame; works with numbers or Vector3. Good base for springy UI scale/offset.

title: FrameManager (one frame at a time)
desc: Opens one frame at a time with a slide-up tween; buttons wired as Open/Close/Toggle.

title: UI initializer with name-based button binding
desc: Hides frames on boot, binds HUD buttons to frames by name, hover/press animations, opens menus from pads or by distance.

title: HUD stats controller
desc: Syncs HUD labels with leaderstats and wires product, random-item and invite buttons with button animations.

title: HUD panel pop (UIScale)
desc: HUD buttons pop panels open/closed by tweening a UIScale, one panel at a time, reset on respawn.

title: Single open ScreenGui handler
desc: Disables the other listed ScreenGuis whenever one becomes enabled.

title: Global window pop-in effect
desc: Watches every Main/Window/Panel frame and pops it in from 80% scale when shown.

title: UI router (module per screen)
desc: Loads every UI module, runs init/start, and opens/closes screens by name with one open at a time.

title: FrameAnimator (blur, FOV, HUD slide)
desc: Full frame manager with size/fade tweens, blur, FOV zoom, HUD sliding off-screen and button/part triggers.

title: HUD slide off-screen by area
desc: Slides HUD edge groups off-screen when the player leaves home, using a manual Heartbeat lerp.

title: UIStroke screen scaler
desc: Scales every UIStroke thickness by screen width relative to 1920 px.

title: GUI helpers (open frame + FOV)
desc: Open a frame with slide and FOV tween while closing others, loading overlay, text popups, alert.

title: Hide/show HUD groups
desc: Slides the left, right and bottom HUD groups off-screen and back.

title: Side buttons toggle frames
desc: Side buttons slide on hover and toggle the same-named frame; close buttons wired on every frame.

title: GUI indexer + mouse unlock
desc: Indexes every ScreenGui child by name and provides a Modal button to free the mouse in first person.

title: GuiManager widget framework
desc: Registers windows and widgets (tabs, sliders, toggles, dropdowns, lists, radial menu) and closes all windows.

title: Gamepad-aware Window class
desc: Tweened show/hide, blur, cancel/B to close, per-window gamepad actions and selection focus.

title: TabGroup class
desc: Keeps one tab pressed, fires TabChanged, cycles tabs with L1/R1.

title: Tab button class
desc: Single tab button used by TabGroup with pressed/unpressed styles.

title: Dropdown menu widget
desc: Expandable option list that fires opened/selected events.

title: Gamepad radial menu
desc: Picks one of six wedges from the thumbstick angle.

title: Slider widget
desc: Draggable 0-1 slider for mouse, touch and gamepad.

title: WindowManager (pattern)
desc: One-open-at-a-time windows with optional stack/Back, UIScale pop, blur, HUD hiding, gamepad B close, auto-binding.

title: DeviceScaler (pattern)
desc: UIScale per ScreenGui by screen size plus PC/Touch/Gamepad detection with a change event.

title: TabGroup (pattern)
desc: Tab buttons and pages matched by name, one selected, Changed event, L1/R1 cycling.

title: InputBinder (pattern)
desc: Keyboard/gamepad keys bound to UI actions with conditions, typing guard, per-device key hints and touch buttons.

title: Number abbreviation (adaptive decimals)
desc: Abbreviates numbers with a 100+ entry suffix list (k, M, B ... Ce), 2/1/0 decimals depending on size, trailing zeros stripped, %.2e fallback past the list.

title: Commas, clock time, abbreviation
desc: Three helpers: FormatNumber adds thousands commas, FormatTime gives mm:ss or h:mm:ss, Abbreviate gives 1.5M style text with a long suffix list.

title: Truncating suffix formatter
desc: One-function abbreviator that FLOORS to N decimals instead of rounding, so 1999 shows 1.99K and never more money than the player has.

title: Number + timer formats, roman numerals
desc: short() suffix formatter, decimal(), commas() via reverse+gsub, colon/short/long timer formats with auto unit choice, and roman numeral to/from (for tiers like 'Rebirth IV').

title: UserId -> name cache
desc: Tiny function that caches GetNameFromUserIdAsync results so boards and UIs do not call the web API repeatedly.

title: Table helpers (map/filter/deep get/set)
desc: Functional table helpers: all, once, filter, max/min by mapper, entries, match, length, map, sort, and deep set/get by path, deep compare and deep copy.

title: Minimal table helpers
desc: DeepCopy (keys too), ShallowCopy, ArrayToSet, SetToArray (sorted) and SanitizeKey.

title: Weighted random pick
desc: chance(d) picks a key from a {key = weight} dictionary with a cumulative-weight roll.

title: Simple object pool
desc: Minimal object pool: get() reuses a returned instance or clones the template, back() puts one back.

title: One remote, many named channels
desc: Network module that sends every call through ONE RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction with a name, plus the same API for bindables; Fired/Invoked return a disconnect function.

title: Remote binder with xpcall
desc: Creates remotes on demand in one folder (asserting the class), wraps every handler in xpcall with a traceback, and returns a friendly error from failed RemoteFunctions instead of throwing to the client.

title: Remotes grouped per service
desc: Creates RF/RE folders per service on demand (Knit-style layout) and binds functions / fires events by service + name.

title: Per-player per-key cooldown limiter
desc: Allow(player, key, cooldown) returns false (and the time left) until the cooldown for that key has passed; Forget(player) on leave.

title: Fallback handlers + remote logger (dev tool)
desc: Gives every RemoteFunction that has no handler one that returns nil (so clients never hang forever) and logs the first calls to each remote with argument types.

title: Format (numbers, time, odds, parsing)
desc: Abbreviate (rounding or truncating, carry 999.95K -> 1M), Commas, Clock, Short/Long durations, Ago, Percent, Odds ('1 in 2.5K'), Parse('2.5M'), Ordinal.

title: Net (validated, rate-limited remotes)
desc: Remote wrapper: server-created remotes in one folder, per-handler argument type schema (rejects NaN/inf/huge strings), token-bucket rate limit per player, pcall'd handlers, (ok, ...) replies.

title: Toolkit (weighted random, cooldown, pool)
desc: WeightedPicker with luck multiplier for rare entries and seeds, Cooldown/Debounce keyed by anything, and an object Pool with prewarm and max size.

title: EffectUtility
desc: Attribute-driven emit helper + Beam transparency tween (keypoint by keypoint).

title: VFX library
desc: Compact VFX library: copy-to-position, follow, rescale, emit by attributes, tag-driven emit loops.

title: Particle helpers
desc: Highest-lifetime lookup, emit all, toggle, scale lifetime, tween model scale.

title: Fx controller (burst / attach / aura / mesh / projectile / light)
desc: Most complete VFX controller: burst, attach-to-part, full-body aura, growing mesh shockwave, projectile, light flash.

title: Limb trails
desc: Attach a trail or particle part to a limb for N seconds, then let it fade in place.

title: Ability: charge, projectile, explosion
desc: Reference ability timeline: charge-up tweens -> projectile -> multi-emitter explosion -> knockback.

title: Barrage arms + shockwaves
desc: Bezier-curve ghost arms + tiny shockwave rings for a barrage / rapid punch.

title: Black hole portal
desc: Procedural layered portal (open / close / flare / suck) animated every frame.

title: Boss aura with distance culling
desc: Client aura manager: idle/run emitter rates, pulsing glow, flickering arcs, distance culling at 8 Hz.

title: Headshot screen effect
desc: Hit-confirm screen punch: blur + color correction + small FOV dip.

title: Flashbang screen
desc: Flashbang: white frame in 0.15 s, hold, fade out 3 s, ear ringing.

title: Bullet impact & blood FX
desc: Per-material bullet impacts oriented to the surface normal, tinted to the hit part, plus blood.

title: Firework burst
desc: Ring of firework bursts with staged emits and safe sound cleanup.

title: Confetti FX
desc: Self-contained UI confetti + world burst for rewards / celebrations.

title: Death effect module
desc: Cosmetic death effect as a function(char) module (how MM2 stores death effects).

title: Lightning fade
desc: Tiny classic: fade a bolt model out frame by frame.

title: EffectPlayer (pattern)
desc: Clone any effect template to a position or onto a part, emit by attributes, auto cleanup, Stop() for loops.

title: ScreenEffects (pattern)
desc: Flash, color tint pulse, blur pulse and desaturate, safe to call repeatedly.

title: Lightning (pattern)
desc: Procedural jagged lightning bolts with branches, light flash and flicker; crackling arcs between parts.

title: Shockwave (pattern)
desc: Expanding ground ring, expanding sphere, and a crater of rocks that copy the ground's material.
